Where This Starts

Three brands.
One platform.

Maristo Hospitality operates two of the UAE’s most distinct dining concepts: German Doner Kebab, with 14 locations across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, and Sisi’s Eatery, a premium Viennese café-restaurant in Dubai Hills. Together with Ambrosia Gulf — the UAE master franchise behind Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters, which opened its first UAE café at BurJuman in July 2026 — this is a portfolio spanning QSR, premium casual dining, and specialty coffee.

District is the UAE’s premium going-out platform — dining, events, and experiences — built for the highest-intent consumer in the region. For a portfolio like this, it is not just a channel. It is the right audience for all three brands at once.
